itinerary.title: Day 2 - Heritage Hanoi: Mausoleum, Pagoda & Temple
description: This half-day introduction to Hanoi focuses on the capital’s essential cultural landmarks at an unhurried pace. With a private historian guide, you visit the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum Complex, One Pillar Pagoda, and the elegant Temple of Literature, Vietnam’s first national university. itinerary.title: Day 3 - Local Hanoi by Jeep: Cuisine, Backstreets & Train Street
description:
Your Hanoi Jeep Tour begins with hotel pick-up in the Hanoi Old Quarter, followed by a safety briefing with your guide and driver. The journey introduces both the elegant and hidden sides of the capital, passing the Hanoi Opera House, local backstreets, alleyways, markets, homes and everyday neighbourhoods that reveal how Hanoians truly live, work and gather.
The route continues past major landmarks such as the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, Thanh Nien Road, West Lake, Truc Bach Lake, Banana Island, and Tran Quoc Pagoda. You also explore quieter local areas, bonsai streets, hidden lanes and the B52 aircraft site, before ending with authentic Hanoi dishes at selected local restaurants and food stalls.
activities: Local food, St. Joseph’s Cathedral, French Quarter, Hanoi Opera House, Long Bien Bridge, West Lake, Train Street

itinerary.title: Day 4 - Scenic Ha Long: Luxury Cruise & Limestone Seascape
description:
After breakfast, you travel by private transfer from Hanoi to Ha Long Bay, where the pace begins to slow as the city gives way to coastal scenery. Upon arrival at the marina, board the distinguished Celina of the Sea Cruise and check into your Executive Balcony suite.
Lunch is served onboard as the cruise begins moving through the UNESCO-listed seascape of limestone islands, quiet coves, and open water. The afternoon may include selected cruise activities depending on the confirmed route and weather. As evening falls over Ha Long Bay, you enjoy dinner onboard and spend the night surrounded by one of Vietnam’s most iconic natural landscapes.
activities: Ha Long Bay, Luxury cruise, Birthday arrangement.

itinerary.title: Day 5 - Seamless Hoi An: Coastal Flight & Bespoke Tailoring
description:
Begin the day with the calm atmosphere of Ha Long Bay, where the cruise may include a light onboard activity, final scenic passage, or relaxed time on deck. After disembarkation, you transfer for a domestic flight to Da Nang, continuing the journey from northern seascapes to Central Vietnam.
Upon arrival, your private chauffeur provides a seamless transfer to Anantara Hoi An Resort. Later, you enjoy a premium bespoke tailoring consultation in Hoi An, a hallmark experience of this historic trading port. The session introduces selected fabrics, silhouettes, and personal styling, creating a refined connection to the town’s artisan tradition.

itinerary.title: Day 6 - Immersive Hoi An: Ancient Town, Lanterns & Riverfront
description:
Your afternoon begins with pick-up from your Hoi An hotel before heading to Cam Thanh Coconut Village. Here, you enjoy a peaceful boat trip through the coconut forest, try paddling a traditional bamboo basket boat, and watch a lively basket-boat performance before continuing to Hoi An Ancient Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
In Hoi An, you explore key cultural landmarks including the Traditional Performing Arts House, Museum of Trade Ceramics, Tan Ky Ancient House, Cantonese Assembly Hall, and the iconic Japanese Covered Bridge. As evening falls, enjoy the lantern-lit Hoi An Night Market, a local specialty dinner, then take a gentle Hoai River boat ride and release flower lanterns for good luck.
activities: Cam Thank Coconut Village, Hoi An Ancient Town, Hoi An Night Market, Hoai River

itinerary.title: Day 7 - Relaxed Hoi An: Memories & Traditional Dance
description:
The day begins with a specialized photography experience in Hoi An Ancient Town, arranged during the best available light for portraits of you and your friends. The session captures your group against lantern-lined streets, heritage façades, quiet alleys, and the riverside scenery of the Thu Bon River, creating a personal visual memory of the journey.
On the afternoon, the day speeds up by a private traditional dance session. The Premium Vietnamese Folk Dance Experience invites your group into the grace and colour of Vietnamese tradition through movement, music, costume and storytelling. Guided by professional instructors and a bilingual host, participants learn simple folk dance gestures using conical hats, fans, scarves and lanterns, then come together for a joyful final performance.
activities: Hoi An Ancient Town, Photography experience, Folk Dance Experience

itinerary.title: Day 9 - Elevated Ba Na: Golden Bridge & French Village
description:
Today’s excursion leads to the elevated mountain resort of Ba Na Hills, where cooler air, forested slopes, and panoramic views create a dramatic contrast to the coast. You enjoy priority arrangements for the cable car system before reaching the world-famous Golden Bridge, framed by giant stone hands and mountain scenery.
With your private guide, the visit continues through the French Village, landscaped gardens, viewpoints, and selected leisure areas within the resort complex. The day is paced to allow time for photography and exploration without unnecessary rush. In the late afternoon, you descend by cable car and return to your beachfront villa in Da Nang.

itinerary.title: Day 10 – Imperial Hue: Citadel, Royal Tombs & River Heritage
description:
Depart from Da Nang City in the morning and journey north toward Hue, following one of Central Vietnam’s most scenic coastal routes. Cross the legendary Hai Van Pass, where mountain roads open to sweeping views of the sea, then pause at Lap An Lagoon and Lang Co Beach, known for calm water, mountain reflections and a long white-sand shoreline. Enjoy lunch near Lang Co before continuing into Hue’s imperial landscape.
In the afternoon, explore the Hue Imperial City, the former royal seat of the Nguyen Dynasty, including the historic Imperial Citadel. Continue to Khai Dinh King’s Tomb, admired for its blend of Eastern artistry and Western architecture. Time permitting, visit Thien Mu Pagoda before returning comfortably to Da Nang.
activities: Hai Van Pass, Lang Co Beach, Imperial Citadel, Khai Dinh King’s Tomb
notes: Starts at 08:00am for about 9 hours (Dress code: Long pants)

itinerary.title: Day 11 - Relaxed Da Nang: Ocean Yacht & Barbecue Dinner
description:
Wake up to the soft coastal light of Da Nang. This morning, you will board a private yacht for a two-hour ocean escape, taking in the open sea, sea breeze and quiet rhythm of Vietnam’s central coastline. A small onboard pantry will be prepared for your comfort, with a thoughtful surprise arranged to make the morning feel even more special.
The afternoon is left entirely for relaxation at your villa, giving you time to enjoy the private pool, unwind by the beach or simply slow down together. As evening arrives, a private barbecue dinner will be arranged at the villa, a warm and intimate coastal finale before you say goodbye to Da Nang the following day.
Highlights:
Free day by the beach, Birthday arrangement, Private barbecue dinner

itinerary.title: Day 13 - Immersive Mekong: Private River Journey & Local Crafts
description:
The day is devoted to an immersive journey into the Mekong Delta, one of Vietnam’s most important agricultural and riverine regions. Travelling by private river vessel, you move through calm waterways, coconut groves, and small canals, observing daily life closely connected to the water.
After lunch in a refined local setting, the programme continues with selected visits to artisanal workshops, family-run producers, fruit gardens, or traditional craft stops. The experience is curated for comfort and authenticity rather than mass tourism, offering a polished yet meaningful view of southern Vietnam before returning to Ho Chi Minh City.

notes: Starts at 08:00am or 09:00am (depends on water flow) for about 10 hours

The journey introduces both the elegant and hidden sides of the capital, passing the Hanoi Opera House, local backstreets, alleyways, markets, homes and everyday neighbourhoods that reveal how Hanoians truly live, work and gather.

The route continues past major landmarks such as the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, Thanh Nien Road, West Lake, Truc Bach Lake, Banana Island, and Tran Quoc Pagoda. You also explore quieter local areas, bonsai streets, hidden lanes and the B52 aircraft site, before ending with authentic Hanoi dishes at selected local restaurants and food stalls.

The afternoon may include selected cruise activities depending on the confirmed route and weather. As evening falls over Ha Long Bay, you enjoy dinner onboard and spend the night surrounded by one of Vietnam’s most iconic natural landscapes.

Here, you enjoy a peaceful boat trip through the coconut forest, try paddling a traditional bamboo basket boat, and watch a lively basket-boat performance before continuing to Hoi An Ancient Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
In Hoi An, you explore key cultural landmarks including the Traditional Performing Arts House, Museum of Trade Ceramics, Tan Ky Ancient House, Cantonese Assembly Hall, and the iconic Japanese Covered Bridge. As evening falls, enjoy the lantern-lit Hoi An Night Market, a local specialty dinner, then take a gentle Hoai River boat ride and release flower lanterns for good luck.

The session captures your group against lantern-lined streets, heritage façades, quiet alleys, and the riverside scenery of the Thu Bon River, creating a personal visual memory of the journey.

itinerary_days.title: Day 10 – Imperial Hue: Citadel, Royal Tombs & River Heritage
description:
Depart from Da Nang City in the morning and journey north toward Hue, following one of Central Vietnam’s most scenic coastal routes. Cross the legendary Hai Van Pass, where mountain roads open to sweeping views of the sea, then pause at Lap An Lagoon and Lang Co Beach, known for calm water, mountain reflections and a long white-sand shoreline. Enjoy lunch near Lang Co before continuing into Hue’s imperial landscape.
In the afternoon, explore the Hue Imperial City, the former royal seat of the Nguyen Dynasty, including the historic Imperial Citadel. Continue to Khai Dinh King’s Tomb, admired for its blend of Eastern artistry and Western architecture. Time permitting, visit Thien Mu Pagoda before returning comfortably to Da Nang.
activities: Hai Van Pass, Lang Co Beach, Imperial Citadel, Khai Dinh King’s Tomb
notes: Starts at 08:00am for about 9 hours (Dress code: Long pants)

itinerary.summary: Upon arrival at Noi Bai International Airport, guests are warmly received by our dedicated concierge team and escorted via luxury private transfer to the Peridot Grand Luxury Boutique Hotel. The evening features a curated welcome dinner, offering a sophisticated introduction to Northern Vietnamese culinary traditions in a refined setting.

The day is devoted to a comprehensive exploration of Hanoi’s rich heritage. Accompanied by a private historian guide, the itinerary includes exclusive visits to the city's most significant cultural landmarks. The pace is deliberately unhurried, ensuring an immersive and private experience away from standard tourist routes.

Guests depart Hanoi for the spectacular landscapes of Ninh Binh. The program features a private sampan excursion through the tranquil waterways and majestic limestone karsts of Trang An. This meticulously arranged day trip offers a profound connection with Vietnam's natural beauty with the utmost privacy.

A private transfer conveys guests to the coastal city of Ha Long to board the distinguished Celina Of The Sea Cruise. After checking into the Executive Balcony suite, the afternoon is spent cruising through the UNESCO World Heritage seascape. As evening approaches, the crew will execute a seamlessly orchestrated birthday celebration, complete with a bespoke private dinner arrangement.

Following a leisurely morning on the cruise, guests disembark and are transferred for a short domestic flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival, a private chauffeur provides a seamless transfer to the Anantara Hoi An Resort. The afternoon includes a premium bespoke tailoring consultation, a hallmark experience of this historic trading port.

A full-day guided exploration of the beautifully preserved Hoi An Ancient Town. The private tour delves into the architectural marvels and rich trading history of the area. The evening concludes with a refined dining experience, showcasing the intricate flavors of Central Vietnamese cuisine.

The morning features a specialized photography tour, designed to capture professional portraits of the family against the iconic, lantern-lit backdrop of Hoi An. The afternoon is reserved for leisure, allowing guests to fully enjoy the premium amenities and tranquil environment of the Anantara Resort.

The journey continues with a transfer to the coastal city of Da Nang, coupled with a curated half-day city tour highlighting local cultural landmarks. Guests will then check into a spectacular 3-Bedroom Beach Front Pool Villa at the Hyatt Regency Danang Resort and Spa, providing an unparalleled standard of privacy and comfort.

A premium excursion to the elevated resort of Ba Na Hills. The itinerary includes priority access to the cable car system and a guided walk across the architectural masterpiece, the Golden Bridge. Guests will explore the French Village before returning to the sanctuary of their beachfront villa.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private transfer, Ba Na Hills ticket.

itinerary.summary: A full-day excursion to the former imperial capital of Hue. The privately guided itinerary encompasses the majestic Imperial Citadel and the opulent royal mausoleums, offering an in-depth perspective on Vietnam's regal history and architectural grandeur under the Nguyen Dynasty.

A day allocated entirely for leisure at the beachfront villa, allowing guests to relax by their private pool or partake in the resort's luxury wellness offerings. The evening is highlighted by a second, meticulously planned birthday celebration—an exclusive dining experience orchestrated by the resort’s culinary team within the privacy of the villa.

Following a seamless domestic flight to Ho Chi Minh City, guests embark on a privately guided tour of the historic Cu Chi Tunnels, gaining insight into this remarkable underground network. The day concludes with check-in at The Reverie Saigon, an establishment renowned for its opulent Italian design and world-class service.

An immersive full-day journey into the Mekong Delta. Traveling aboard a private luxury river vessel, guests observe the vibrant riverine culture and visit local artisanal workshops. This carefully curated excursion provides a sophisticated and comfortable approach to exploring one of Vietnam's most vital agricultural regions.

The final morning is at the guests' leisure to enjoy the premium facilities of The Reverie Saigon. At the appropriate time, a private chauffeur will provide a seamless transfer to Tan Son Nhat International Airport for the departing flight, concluding a flawlessly executed luxury journey.

The route continues past major landmarks such as the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, Thanh Nien Road, West Lake, Truc Bach Lake, Banana Island, and Tran Quoc Pagoda. You also explore quieter local areas, bonsai streets, hidden lanes and the B52 aircraft site, before ending with authentic Hanoi dishes at selected local restaurants and food stalls.
edited_fields.day_highlights_3: Local food, St. Joseph’s Cathedral, French Quarter, Hanoi Opera House, Long Bien Bridge, West Lake, Train Street
edited_fields.day_title_4: Day 4 - Scenic Ha Long: Luxury Cruise & Limestone Seascape
edited_fields.day_desc_4_0:
After breakfast, you travel by private transfer from Hanoi to Ha Long Bay, where the pace begins to slow as the city gives way to coastal scenery. Upon arrival at the marina, board the distinguished Celina of the Sea Cruise and check into your Executive Balcony suite.

Lunch is served onboard as the cruise begins moving through the UNESCO-listed seascape of limestone islands, quiet coves, and open water. The afternoon may include selected cruise activities depending on the confirmed route and weather. As evening falls over Ha Long Bay, you enjoy dinner onboard and spend the night surrounded by one of Vietnam’s most iconic natural landscapes.
edited_fields.day_highlights_4: Ha Long Bay, Luxury cruise, Birthday arrangement.
edited_fields.day_title_5: Day 5 - Seamless Hoi An: Coastal Flight & Bespoke Tailoring
edited_fields.day_desc_5_0:
Begin the day with the calm atmosphere of Ha Long Bay, where the cruise may include a light onboard activity, final scenic passage, or relaxed time on deck. After disembarkation, you transfer for a domestic flight to Da Nang, continuing the journey from northern seascapes to Central Vietnam.

Upon arrival, your private chauffeur provides a seamless transfer to Anantara Hoi An Resort. Later, you enjoy a premium bespoke tailoring consultation in Hoi An, a hallmark experience of this historic trading port. The session introduces selected fabrics, silhouettes, and personal styling, creating a refined connection to the town’s artisan tradition.
edited_fields.day_title_6: Day 6 - Immersive Hoi An: Ancient Town, Lanterns & Riverfront
edited_fields.day_desc_6_0:
Your afternoon begins with pick-up from your Hoi An hotel before heading to Cam Thanh Coconut Village. Here, you enjoy a peaceful boat trip through the coconut forest, try paddling a traditional bamboo basket boat, and watch a lively basket-boat performance before continuing to Hoi An Ancient Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

In Hoi An, you explore key cultural landmarks including the Traditional Performing Arts House, Museum of Trade Ceramics, Tan Ky Ancient House, Cantonese Assembly Hall, and the iconic Japanese Covered Bridge. As evening falls, enjoy the lantern-lit Hoi An Night Market, a local specialty dinner, then take a gentle Hoai River boat ride and release flower lanterns for good luck.
edited_fields.day_highlights_6: Cam Thank Coconut Village, Hoi An Ancient Town, Hoi An Night Market, Hoai River
edited_fields.day_title_7: Day 7 - Relaxed Hoi An: Memories & Traditional Dance
edited_fields.day_desc_7_0:
The day begins with a specialized photography experience in Hoi An Ancient Town, arranged during the best available light for portraits of you and your friends. The session captures your group against lantern-lined streets, heritage façades, quiet alleys, and the riverside scenery of the Thu Bon River, creating a personal visual memory of the journey.

On the afternoon, the day speeds up by a private traditional dance session. The Premium Vietnamese Folk Dance Experience invites your group into the grace and colour of Vietnamese tradition through movement, music, costume and storytelling. Guided by professional instructors and a bilingual host, participants learn simple folk dance gestures using conical hats, fans, scarves and lanterns, then come together for a joyful final performance.
edited_fields.day_highlights_7: Hoi An Ancient Town, Photography experience, Folk Dance Experience
edited_fields.day_title_8: Day 8 - Coastal Da Nang: Farewell Moment & Spa Experience
edited_fields.day_desc_8_0: The journey continues to Da Nang, where some friends say goodbye to Vietnam while others continue the coastal chapter of the trip.
edited_fields.day_highlights_8: Airport transfer, Spa Experience, Free afternoon
edited_fields.day_title_9: Day 9 - Elevated Ba Na: Golden Bridge & French Village
edited_fields.day_desc_9_0:
Today’s excursion leads to the elevated mountain resort of Ba Na Hills, where cooler air, forested slopes, and panoramic views create a dramatic contrast to the coast. You enjoy priority arrangements for the cable car system before reaching the world-famous Golden Bridge, framed by giant stone hands and mountain scenery.

With your private guide, the visit continues through the French Village, landscaped gardens, viewpoints, and selected leisure areas within the resort complex. The day is paced to allow time for photography and exploration without unnecessary rush. In the late afternoon, you descend by cable car and return to your beachfront villa in Da Nang.
edited_fields.day_highlights_9: Ba Na Hills, Golden Bridge, French Village
edited_fields.day_title_10: Day 10 – Imperial Hue: Citadel, Royal Tombs & River Heritage
edited_fields.day_desc_10_0:
Depart from Da Nang City in the morning and journey north toward Hue, following one of Central Vietnam’s most scenic coastal routes. Cross the legendary Hai Van Pass, where mountain roads open to sweeping views of the sea, then pause at Lap An Lagoon and Lang Co Beach, known for calm water, mountain reflections and a long white-sand shoreline. Enjoy lunch near Lang Co before continuing into Hue’s imperial landscape.

In the afternoon, explore the Hue Imperial City, the former royal seat of the Nguyen Dynasty, including the historic Imperial Citadel. Continue to Khai Dinh King’s Tomb, admired for its blend of Eastern artistry and Western architecture. Time permitting, visit Thien Mu Pagoda before returning comfortably to Da Nang.
edited_fields.day_highlights_10: Hai Van Pass, Lang Co Beach, Imperial Citadel, Khai Dinh King’s Tomb
edited_fields.day_note_10_0: Starts at 08:00am for about 9 hours (Dress code: Long pants)
edited_fields.day_title_11: Day 11 - Relaxed Da Nang: Ocean Yacht & Barbecue Dinner
edited_fields.day_highlights_11: Free day by the beach, Birthday arrangement, Private barbecue dinner
edited_fields.day_desc_11_0:
Wake up to the soft coastal light of Da Nang. This morning, you will board a private yacht for a two-hour ocean escape, taking in the open sea, sea breeze and quiet rhythm of Vietnam’s central coastline. A small onboard pantry will be prepared for your comfort, with a thoughtful surprise arranged to make the morning feel even more special.

The afternoon is left entirely for relaxation at your villa, giving you time to enjoy the private pool, unwind by the beach or simply slow down together. As evening arrives, a private barbecue dinner will be arranged at the villa, a warm and intimate coastal finale before you say goodbye to Da Nang the following day.

Highlights: Free day by the beach, Birthday arrangement, Private barbecue dinner
edited_fields.day_title_12: Day 12 - Meaningful Saigon: Cu Chi Tunnels & Veteran Encounter
edited_fields.day_desc_12_0: After a domestic flight to Ho Chi Minh City, you continue by private transfer to the historic Cu Chi Tunnels. The experience offers insight into the underground network used during wartime and is elevated by an exclusive meeting with a war veteran, subject to final availability. The day concludes with check-in at The Reverie Saigon, known for opulent Italian design and world-class service.
edited_fields.day_highlights_12: Domestic flight, Cu Chi Tunnel, Meet up with War veteran
edited_fields.day_note_12_0: Starts at 10:00am, duration depends on flight status
edited_fields.day_title_13: Day 13 - Immersive Mekong: Private River Journey & Local Crafts
edited_fields.day_desc_13_0:
The day is devoted to an immersive journey into the Mekong Delta, one of Vietnam’s most important agricultural and riverine regions. Travelling by private river vessel, you move through calm waterways, coconut groves, and small canals, observing daily life closely connected to the water.

After lunch in a refined local setting, the programme continues with selected visits to artisanal workshops, family-run producers, fruit gardens, or traditional craft stops. The experience is curated for comfort and authenticity rather than mass tourism, offering a polished yet meaningful view of southern Vietnam before returning to Ho Chi Minh City.
edited_fields.day_highlights_13: Ben Tre, Mekong Delta, Boat trip
edited_fields.day_note_13_0: Starts at 08:00am or 09:00am (depends on water flow) for about 10 hours
edited_fields.day_desc_14_0: The final morning is left at leisure at The Reverie Saigon, allowing you to enjoy breakfast, the hotel’s premium facilities, or a quiet walk near the Saigon River before departure. At the appropriate time, your private chauffeur provides a seamless transfer to Tan Son Nhat International Airport, concluding a carefully arranged luxury journey across Vietnam.
